segments.name: Site preparation
segments.description: Provides site preparation and complementary construction services for residential, commercial, industrial, retail and state infrastructure customers in the Southeast United States.
segments.evidence: The CODM manages the business activities on a consolidated basis and as such the Company determined it is a single reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for construction projects, with all revenue derived from construction projects based in North Carolina and South Carolina.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company derives all revenue in the United States of America from construction projects based in North Carolina and South Carolina in 2025, 2024, and 2023.
